tools.title: Four free tools, four questions answered.
tools.description: Measure selection, check commerce protocols, find WebMCP source evidence, or watch a live agent work through a storefront. No credit card required.

items.title: AI Agent Score Scan
items.description: Run a one-time simulation of your top 10 products across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. See where you win, where you lose, and what to fix first.

items.title: UCP Validator
items.description: Check whether a storefront publishes a valid Universal Commerce Profile at /.well-known/ucp and whether major shopping agents are allowed in robots.txt.

items.title: UCP Playground
items.description: Drive a real AI shopping agent against any UCP-compliant storefront. Search catalogs, build carts, start checkout, and inspect every tool call.

items.title: WebMCP scanner
items.description: Review WebMCP across eight store operations, from product search and variant selection to carts, checkout handoffs, and orders. Get source evidence and practical fixes for your shopping workflows.
features: Practical store fixes backed by source

meta.description: Free ecentic resources for merchants and builders: AI Agent Score Scan, UCP Validator, WebMCP scanner, UCP Playground, guides, and public agent APIs.
